title: Majority after bribing the head coordinates
statement: Let $k,m$ be natural numbers, let $b\in\{-1,1\}$, and let $x$ be a sign vector of length $k+m$. Bribing the first $k$ coordinates of majority to $b$ yields the threshold sign of $kb$ plus the sum of the last $m$ coordinates of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $k+m$
